tool.name: krepp seek
tool.description: estimate distances of query sequences to a sketch

param.name: sketch
param.label: Krepp sketch
param.help: Sketch file produced by krepp sketch

param.name: query
param.label: Query sequences
param.help: FASTA or FASTQ file containing query sequences

tool.help:
**What it does**
Estimates distances of query sequences to a pre-built krepp sketch. This is the one-to-one counterpart of `krepp dist`, using a single sketch instead of a multi-reference index.
**Output**
A tab-separated file with columns:
- **SEQ_ID**: query sequence identifier - **DIST**: estimated distance (mismatch rate)
@ATTRIBUTION@
